Retail Tenant Shell Model

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create an OpenStudio 3.10 one-story retail tenant shell model and save the required output as /home/user/Desktop/result.osm.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains /home/user/Desktop/result.osm with size at least 500 bytes.
2. /home/user/Desktop/result.osm contains exactly one OS:Version object whose version identifier starts with 3.10.
3. /home/user/Desktop/result.osm contains exactly 1 OS:Building, 1 OS:BuildingStory, 5 OS:Space objects, and 5 OS:ThermalZone objects.
4. The OS:Space names are exactly Tenant-1, Tenant-2, Tenant-3, Tenant-4, and Service-Corridor.
5. Every OS:Space references the OS:BuildingStory, references an OS:ThermalZone, has Part of Total Floor Area set to Yes, and has floor area greater than 0.05 m2.
6. /home/user/Desktop/result.osm contains at least one OS:DefaultConstructionSet and the single OS:Building references a default construction set.
7. The model has exactly 33 OS:Surface objects: 5 Floor surfaces, 5 RoofCeiling surfaces, and 23 Wall surfaces.
8. The surface Outside Boundary Condition counts are exactly 5 Ground, 14 Outdoors, and 14 Surface.
9. The model has exactly 4 OS:SubSurface objects, all counted window subsurfaces are FixedWindow, and the fixed-window count is exactly 4.
10. The surface geometry bounding box has X span 36.00 m, Y span 12.00 m, and Z span 4.00 m, each with tolerance +/-0.05 m.
11. The sum of floor surface areas is 432.00 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2.
12. The sum of exterior wall gross areas is 384.00 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2.
13. The total fixed-window area is 50.40 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
